headline: JSW Energy convenes shareholder and creditor meetings pursuant to NCLT order for scheme of arrangement
sum: JSW Energy notified the NSE of shareholder and unsecured creditor meetings convened under an NCLT (Mumbai Bench) order dated 2 June 2026, signalling a formal scheme of arrangement or debt restructuring requiring dual approval paths.
detail: JSW Energy Limited informed the NSE of proceedings in relation to meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors, both convened under the authority of an NCLT order dated 2 June 2026 from the Mumbai Bench. The filing on 20 July 2026 suggests the company had completed or was completing the notice-and-conduct phase for these dual meetings. The involvement of both equity shareholders and unsecured creditors indicates either a merger/amalgamation with debt component, a substantial capital restructuring, or a debt-to-equity conversion scheme. The specific counterparty, terms, and consideration remain undisclosed in available public filings.
